presentation.label: MONO SYNTH
presentation.summary: SY MONO: a monophonic digital oscillator voice, saw and pulse with a sub, noise and a pitch LFO, through the Rytm's own analog filter and AMP.
presentation.overview: An original take on a small monosynth's oscillator section, computed on the Rytm's ColdFire at 48 kHz. One band-limited oscillator gives a saw and a pulse, a sub one or two octaves down and white noise mix in, and a triangle LFO of the machine's own bends the pitch for vibrato, trills and wobbles. The track's own analog filter, AMP and OVR shape it.
highlights: A sub one or two octaves down on one knob.
A pitch LFO from 0.1 to 30 Hz, up to three octaves deep.
Tap encoder A for the range: 16', 8', 4', 2'.
usage: Select the BD track, press FUNC + SRC, choose SY MONO and press YES.
Shape it with the FLTR and AMP pages, as any Rytm voice.
MOD 20 is a vibrato; raise LFO for a trill.

access.location: The machine list of any track on pads 1 to 8 (BD, SD, RS, CP, BT, LT, MT, HT): SY MONO, in the SY section. Its SYNTH page.
steps: Select a track and press FUNC + SRC.
Choose SY MONO and press YES.
On the SYNTH page, tap encoder A to step the range.

limitations: Built for OS 1.74 only, on the Modwerk base's digital voices.

Offered on pads 1 to 8 only: six of the Rytm's eight voices (BD, SD, RS/CP, BT, LT, MT/HT). Tracks that share a voice play one sound at a time. At about 4 % of the audio block a voice, six playing at once fill what the digital voices have; it is not offered on the hi-hats and cymbals.
A voice goes quiet once its AMP decay has surely ended (an estimate from the record sent to the amp, with margin); with AMP DEC at INF it keeps rendering.

claims: ui:SYNTH page of the SY MONO machine

load.display: About 3.3 % of the audio block a voice, 4.1 % at worst
load.conditions: The base's mw_voice_meter on one MKII, OS 1.74, build SM01 RAM-booted: one voice, 16 notes over MIDI, 43,344 blocks, mean 3.26 %, dearest block 4.12 % (27 November 2026). SM02, six voices left on the machine at rest: 2.04 % mean, 4.30 % dearest a voice; the voice renders as long as its track keeps the machine.

tests.summary: Host: 31 checks of the oscillators, sub, noise, LFO, smoothing and clipping (tools/host_test.c). Not run on a unit or in rytm-emu.
